protocols.title: Cortexin (10 mg) Dosage Protocol — source reference
protocols.purpose: Individual-page schedule and handling details, transcribed as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. Registered Russian convention reported by page: entire 10 mg vial IM once daily for 10 consecutive days; reconstituted in 1–2 mL diluent; repeat only after 3–6 months. Prescription product in Russia, not FDA-approved; human evidence largely Russian-language and often uncontrolled.

schedule.description: Entire 10 mg vial per day; source says dissolve in 1–2 mL diluent. Repeat after 3–6 months if prescribed.

regimen.notes: Russian registered product schedule; not FDA-approved and not a human-use recommendation for research vials.
